title: Ghostly Reaper on Mountain Lake
description: A large blue melting ghost-like creature with wide yellow eyes and a worried expression stands in the foreground on a misty lake. Behind it, a hooded grim reaper figure in a dark cloak holds a staff while perched on a rocky cliff under a giant red moon, with traditional boats and glowing lanterns floating on the water below.
prompt: A surreal fantasy night scene featuring a large translucent blue melting ghost creature with big yellow eyes and a worried face standing in the foreground of a misty mountain lake. In the background a hooded grim reaper in a dark cloak stands on a rocky cliff holding a staff, under a massive glowing red moon. Traditional wooden boats with lights and many glowing red paper lanterns float across the water, dramatic misty atmosphere, cinematic lighting.
